title: Five Places to Go in Milan
abstract: Isola used to be home to blue-collar workers and mobsters, and felt removed from Milan. It’s now home to Google in Italy, and is seen as radical chic.

title: Five Places to Eat in Versailles
abstract: The culinary reputation of Versailles is in the midst of a delicious revival as talented chefs open restaurants so good they’re pulling Parisians.
